contract.title: Wave A: scripts/ranking-judgments.mjs graded-judgment parser
contract.invariant: Unjudged candidates remain explicitly unjudged (judged flag), never become grade 0, and are excluded from pair generation. Tuning-only human-authoritative grades 3/2/1/0 with source-bound rationale.
production_callers: (no base runtime caller; Wave C consumers per §7.2: C1 judgment packets, C5 v4 tuning manifest)
interface_changes: scripts/ranking-judgments.mjs (new file; judgment parser per §6.2 — grades 3/2/1/0, source-bound rationale, explicit judged status)
security_boundaries: Judgment integrity: missing grade is never normalized to zero; unjudged stays explicit and is excluded from pairs (§7.6 A8 RED row unjudged_candidate_never_becomes_grade_zero; §6.2 human-authoritative)
overlap_with: C1 (Wave C): packet manifest covers each tuning task exactly once, requires A8
C5 (Wave C): v4 tuning manifest binds adjudicated judgments, requires A8
R1.3: decision contract + LOFO_FAMILIES.json are sealed prerequisites (A8 requires R1.6, R1.3)
contract.instructions: Create scripts/ranking-judgments.mjs (new file) with the graded-judgment parser per §6.2: tuning-only, human-authoritative grades 3/2/1/0 with source-bound rationale and explicit judged status; unjudged candidates are excluded from pair generation and never become grade 0. §7.6 A8 RED row: test 'unjudged_candidate_never_becomes_grade_zero'; expected failure: missing grade is normalized to zero; minimal passing: unjudged remains explicit and excluded from pairs. Held-out restrictions from §6.2 apply downstream (never read held-out judgments for design/grading/selection). Focused command is plan-specified (§7.5 A8 row, node --test without tsx) and targets a test file absent at round_base: unverifiable-at-base. Affected command pnpm test:scripts is repo-verified (root package.json:26, runs scripts/*.test.mjs) and must stay green.
